questions.prompt: Your supervisor points out a mistake in your work. How should you respond?
options: Explain why everyone else also makes mistakes.
Listen, seek clarification and correct the issue.
Ignore the feedback because you disagree.

questions.prompt: A colleague receives praise from management for excellent performance. How should you respond?
options: Congratulate her and learn from her strengths.
Dismiss her achievement as favouritism without evidence.
Stop cooperating with her because she is receiving attention.

questions.prompt: You are frustrated by a colleague's behaviour. How should you respond?
options: Discuss the issue with other staff to gather support.
Respond angrily to make your feelings clear.
Address the issue calmly or raise it through the appropriate channel.

questions.prompt: You notice a colleague struggling with an unfamiliar procedure. How should you respond?
options: Offer guidance if you are able and authorised to do so.
Mock her for not knowing what to do.
Ignore her because she should already know.
